name: The Picture of Café au lait
source:
This is the story of 3rd high school student named "Takeomi Takagi" The only member who remains in Art club because his undoing in the past. His goal is to win over art competition before his graduation from high school.

He meets “Itsuki Eimi” The cheerful junior high school girl in Basketball club because she ruins his painting that he will send to the competition by accidentally run upon it.

This is the coming-of-age story and love story between two people who have opposite personality. They both have their dream and meet their obstacle together.

“Takagi” The strict and sharp tongue yet kind senior who tries to help Eimi achieve her dream for redeem himself from action in his past.

“Eimi” The cheerful junior who always hide her sadness tries to become real athlete in Basketball club.

Will they achieve their dream or give up?
What future await of them is for you to decide.
translation:
故事的主人公是高三学生Takeomi Takagi。由于过去的所作所为，美术社只剩下他一个人。他的目标，是在高中毕业前赢得绘画比赛。

一次偶遇中，篮球社开朗的低年级女生Itsuki Eimi不慎撞上了他准备送去参赛的画，毁坏了作品，两人因此相识。

这是一段性格截然不同的两人共同成长、相互爱慕的故事。他们各自怀抱梦想，也一同面对阻碍。

“Takagi”是一位严厉毒舌、内心却温柔的学长。他试图帮助Eimi实现梦想，以弥补自己过去的过错。

“Eimi”是一位总把悲伤藏在心里的开朗学妹，努力成为篮球社真正的运动员。

他们会实现梦想，还是就此放弃？
等待两人的未来，将由你决定。
